title_sq: Tek Kompleksi E88, Ne Laprake, Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Organizim Perfekt!
description_sq: Tek Kompleksi E88, Ne Zonen e Laprakes prane Kupoles, Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Orientim Perfekt ! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 6 te nje godine 8 kateshe, me ashensor dhe ndertim i 2024 qe eshte drejt fazes se dorezimit. Prona ka nje siperfaqe brutto 127.51 m2 dhe siperfaqe netto 109.80 m2. Organizohet nga : salloni i ndenjes me kend gatimi dhe me dalje ne ballkon, dhome matrimoniale, dhome femijesh, dy tualete dhe ballkoni. Prona ofron dhe nje post parkimi ndodhet ne katin minus 1 ne vleren 25.000 euro . Orientimi i apartamentit veri perendim mundeson ndricim natyral. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode dhe akses drejt qendres se kryeqytetit. Momentalisht kompleksi eshte ne faze perfundimtare shtrimi me pllake dhe pritet te behet i banueshem shume shpejt gjate muajve ne vazhdim.
title_en: In the E88 Complex, in Laprake, 2+1 apartment for sale with perfect organization!
description_en: In the E88 Complex, in the Laprak area near the Dome, 2+1 Apartment for Sale with Perfect Orientation! The apartment is located on the 6th floor of an 8-story building, with an elevator and construction of 2024, which is nearing the handover stage. The property has a gross area of ​​127.51 m2 and a net area of ​​109.80 m2. It is organized by: living room with kitchenette and exit to the balcony, matrimonial room, children's room, two toilets and balcony. The property also offers a parking post located on the minus 1 floor at a value of 25,000 euros. The north-west orientation of the apartment enables natural lighting. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life and access to the center of the capital. Currently, the complex is in the final stage of tiling and is expected to become habitable very quickly in the coming months.
